viewing_check: Check the RACT badge: is it the heavy chrome crowned grille badge with intact fixing bar, any maker mark, and no cracks; compare with the enamel one that sold for $90. Photograph the back of the Wayfarer plate and the Bedford badge, and look for any brass or enamel Ford or club badges and oiler maker names (Wakefield, Kelvinator style) among the oilers.
